versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Adds ability to extract URLs (full and domain-style) from user-provided text.
- Validates URLs for accessibility and retrieves page titles.
- Detects image URLs and designates them as previewable.
- Presents extraction results in a structured, clear format, including counts, status, and brief descriptions.
- Lists inaccessible URLs as unreachable.
- Prioritizes validation when large numbers of URLs are extracted.
